title: Convergence and Quantum Advantage of Trotterized MERA for Strongly-Correlated Systems
abstract: Demonstrates polynomial quantum advantage in comparison to classical MERA simulations by combining VQE with MERA using Trotter circuits. MERA causal structure reduces required qubits from linear to system-size independent. Improved convergence through layer-by-layer initialization and phase-diagram scanning. Brick-wall and parallel random-pair circuits yield similar accuracies.
key_claims: Polynomial quantum advantage over classical MERA simulations
Qubit count reduced from O(N) to system-size independent via causal structure
Average rotation angles can be reduced with negligible accuracy impact
Greater quantum advantage expected for higher-dimensional systems
